intro.en: Military-spec project cable assemblies connect power, controls, sensors, communications and mission equipment in ground, naval, airborne and deployable systems. The term describes a controlled requirement set—not a universal quality grade. Exact component part numbers, approved sources, workmanship, environment, inspection and acceptance evidence must be defined for each program.
intro.zh: 军规项目电缆组件用于连接地面、舰载、机载及可部署系统中的电源、控制、传感器、通信与任务设备。“军规”代表一套受控要求，而不是通用质量等级；每个项目都必须明确组件准确型号、批准来源、工艺、环境、检验与接收证据。

knowledge.en: A military drawing may invoke one or many specifications covering connectors, wire, contacts, accessories, identification, workmanship, environmental methods or documentation. A component that conforms to one specification does not make the complete assembly qualified. Applicability, revision, class, slash sheet, configuration and qualification status must be read together.
knowledge.zh: 军用图纸可能同时引用连接器、线材、触点、附件、标识、工艺、环境方法或文件管理等多项规范。某个元件符合一项规范，并不代表整套组件已经合格；适用范围、版本、等级、分规范、配置与鉴定状态必须结合审核。

notes.en: Provide platform and installation zone, drawing and revision, contract data requirements, exact connector and accessory PINs, approved manufacturer or QPL constraints, circuit and shield schedule, current and signal characteristics, environmental profiles, routing and support, maintenance concept, marking, traceability, lot size, source inspection and required acceptance or qualification procedures.
notes.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、图纸及版本、合同数据要求、连接器与附件准确型号、批准制造商或 QPL 限制、回路与屏蔽表、电流和信号特性、环境谱、走线与支撑、维修方案、标识、追溯、批量、源检及所需验收或鉴定程序。

delivery.en: Military-related projects are accepted only after capability, information-control, sourcing and compliance review. We can manufacture samples and controlled production assemblies to an agreed technical data package. We do not claim that a part is military-qualified, platform-approved or listed on a QPL unless the exact product, scope and current evidence support that statement.
delivery.zh: 军规相关项目仅在完成能力、信息控制、采购来源与合规审核后承接。我们可依据约定技术数据包制作样品与受控量产组件；除非准确产品、适用范围与当前证据能够支持，否则不会宣称零件已取得军用鉴定、平台批准或列入 QPL。

introduction.en: Translate the Mission Requirement into a Controlled Build
introduction.zh: 把任务要求转化为受控制造

faq.zh: 军规项目电缆组件常见问题

subtitle.en: From exact component identity to field-support evidence
subtitle.zh: 从准确元件身份到现场保障证据

lead.en: Begin with the platform, installation zone and released data. Then reconcile connector series, contacts, wire, shielding, routing, environment, workmanship, inspection and configuration records. Rugged appearance is never a substitute for a controlled requirement.
lead.zh: 先明确平台、安装区域与放行资料，再核对连接器系列、触点、线材、屏蔽、走线、环境、工艺、检验与配置记录。粗犷外观从来不能替代受控要求。

title.en: One category can serve vehicles, shelters, ships, aircraft and test systems
title.zh: 一个小类可覆盖车辆、方舱、舰船、航空与测试系统

copy.en: Military project assemblies include vehicle power and control harnesses, tactical radio and headset leads, rugged Ethernet and serial links, antenna coax, sensor breakouts, launcher or actuator interfaces, battery and distribution cables, shipboard equipment interconnects, avionics support leads and depot test adapters. Each family has different hazards, maintenance conditions and configuration authority. The page describes manufacturing capability for review; it does not imply approval for every platform.
copy.zh: 军规项目组件可包括车辆电源与控制线束、战术电台与耳机连接线、加固以太网与串行链路、天线同轴线、传感器分支、发射或执行器接口、电池与配电电缆、舰载设备互连、航电保障线及维修测试转接线。每类产品的危险、维护条件与配置权限均不同；本页说明可供审核的制造能力，并不代表已获所有平台批准。

copy.en: Internal, exposed, engine-bay, topside, occupied, unmanned and test-only locations require different evidence.
copy.zh: 设备内部、外露、发动机舱、甲板、载人、无人及仅测试区域需要不同证据。

copy.en: Prototype, test, training and operational assemblies need visible status and configuration control.
copy.zh: 原型、试验、训练与任务组件需要清晰状态和配置控制。

title.en: Series, class, insert, contact and keying define the actual interface
title.zh: 系列、等级、孔位、触点与键位共同定义真实接口

copy.en: MIL-DTL-38999, MIL-DTL-5015-derived families and other military circular systems contain many non-interchangeable series, shell classes, finishes, receptacle styles, insert arrangements, contact types and polarization positions. A shorthand connector name is insufficient for procurement or assembly. The exact PIN, mating half, backshell, contacts, sealing hardware and approved source requirements are reconciled before material release.
copy.zh: MIL-DTL-38999、源自 MIL-DTL-5015 的系列及其他军用圆形系统包含大量不可互换的系列、壳体等级、镀层、插座形式、孔位排列、触点类型与键位。简称不足以用于采购或装配；放料前必须核对准确型号、对插件、尾罩、触点、密封附件与批准来源要求。

title.en: Read every position in the PIN

copy.en: Shell size, class, finish, insert, contact style and polarization can change fit, sealing and performance.
copy.zh: 壳体尺寸、等级、镀层、孔位、触点形式与键位都会改变配合、密封与性能。

copy.en: A qualified connector source does not automatically qualify the cable assembly or a substituted accessory.
copy.zh: 获鉴定的连接器来源不会自动使整条电缆组件或替代附件获得鉴定。

title.en: Vehicle and shelter wiring must survive installation and field service
title.zh: 车辆与方舱布线必须兼顾安装和现场维修

copy.en: Tactical vehicles, trailers, generators, shelters, radar stations and mobile command equipment combine vibration, dust, mud, fluids, temperature swings and frequent configuration changes. Harness branches must clear steering, suspension, exhaust, doors, racks and moving mechanisms while remaining inspectable. Protection may use conduit, braid, boots, clamps, grommets and service loops selected from the actual abrasion, snag, water and maintenance exposure.
copy.zh: 战术车辆、拖车、发电机、方舱、雷达站与机动指挥设备同时面临振动、尘土、泥水、油液、温差和频繁改型。线束分支需避开转向、悬架、排气、舱门、机架与运动机构，同时保持可检修。防护可采用波纹管、编织、护套、夹具、护圈与维修余量，并按真实磨损、勾挂、进水和维护暴露选择。

copy.en: Clip spacing, edge clearance, branch take-off and connector support are defined with the installed route.
copy.zh: 夹具间距、边缘间隙、分支出口与连接器支撑需随安装路线一起定义。

copy.en: Access, tool clearance, labels and disconnect sequence matter as much as bench-level workmanship.
copy.zh: 可达性、工具空间、标签与断开顺序和台面工艺同样重要。

title.en: Moisture, salt, fluids and galvanic interfaces require explicit control
title.zh: 湿气、盐雾、油液与电偶界面需要明确控制

copy.en: Shipboard and externally mounted assemblies can encounter condensation, salt atmosphere, spray, washdown, fuels, hydraulic fluids and long storage periods. Jacket and boot compatibility, connector sealing, drain paths, backshell materials, plating combinations, bonding and corrosion prevention are reviewed as a system. Water resistance cannot be inferred from a circular shell or an overmolded appearance; the installed interface and test method define the claim.
copy.zh: 舰载与外部安装组件可能遭受冷凝、盐雾、喷淋、冲洗、燃油、液压油及长期存储。护套与护靴兼容性、连接器密封、排水路径、尾罩材料、镀层组合、搭接与防腐需作为系统审核。圆形外壳或包胶外观不能证明防水，只有安装界面和试验方法才能定义相关声明。

copy.en: Shell, backshell, fastener, shield and structure finishes are checked for the service environment.
copy.zh: 壳体、尾罩、紧固件、屏蔽与结构镀层需针对服役环境审核。

copy.en: Seals, boots and potting must not trap fluid where the equipment design expects drainage.
copy.zh: 密封、护靴与灌封不能在设备设计要求排水的位置困住液体。

title.en: Power, data, RF and audio need separate transmission rules
title.zh: 电源、数据、射频与音频需要各自的传输规则

copy.en: Rugged systems may combine DC power, discrete controls, Ethernet, serial buses, USB, timing, low-level sensors, radio audio and coaxial RF. Each circuit family has its own impedance, return path, pair twist, shield, loss, bend and separation limits. Cable geometry, connector transition, backshell bonding and equipment grounding are reviewed as one signal path; continuity alone cannot demonstrate link performance.
copy.zh: 加固系统可能同时包含直流电源、离散控制、以太网、串行总线、USB、时钟、低电平传感器、电台音频与同轴射频。每类回路都有自身阻抗、回流路径、绞距、屏蔽、损耗、弯曲与隔离限制。电缆几何、连接器过渡、尾罩搭接与设备接地需作为一条信号路径审核，单纯导通不能证明链路性能。

copy.en: Untwist, shield opening and contact transition length are limited at each termination.
copy.zh: 每个端接点都要限制解绞、屏蔽开口和触点过渡长度。

copy.en: Return loss, insertion loss, shielding or functional link tests require defined fixtures and frequency limits.
copy.zh: 回波损耗、插入损耗、屏蔽或功能链路测试需要明确夹具和频率限值。

title.en: Wire designation, temperature and derating must match the circuit
title.zh: 线材牌号、温度与降额必须匹配回路

copy.en: Military and aerospace wire families differ in conductor metal and plating, strand construction, insulation system, wall thickness, voltage rating, temperature range, fluid resistance, smoke and flame behavior, marking and approved usage. Gauge selection considers steady and transient current, bundle size, ambient temperature, installation altitude, voltage drop, protective device and fault clearing. A familiar color or nominal AWG does not prove equivalence.
copy.zh: 军用与航空线材在导体金属及镀层、绞线结构、绝缘体系、壁厚、电压等级、温度范围、耐液体、烟雾与阻燃、标识和批准用途方面均有差异。线径选择需考虑稳态与瞬态电流、束径、环境温度、安装高度、压降、保护器件与故障切除；熟悉的颜色或标称 AWG 不能证明等效。

copy.en: Tin, silver and nickel finishes interact differently with temperature, termination and mating materials.
copy.zh: 镀锡、镀银与镀镍在温度、端接及配合材料方面表现不同。

copy.en: Equivalent claims need drawing authority and evidence across electrical, mechanical and environmental attributes.
copy.zh: 等效替代需要图纸授权，并覆盖电气、机械与环境属性的证据。

title.en: Shield topology is part of the system grounding architecture
title.zh: 屏蔽拓扑属于系统接地架构的一部分

copy.en: Individual pair shields, overall foil or braid, double braid, conduit, conductive backshells, shield rings and drain wires solve different coupling and bonding problems. Pigtail length adds inductance; full-circumference termination can improve higher-frequency behavior when compatible hardware and workmanship are used. Single-end, double-end, chassis and isolated terminations follow the released system design rather than a universal rule.
copy.zh: 单对屏蔽、总箔或总编织、双层编织、导电管、导电尾罩、屏蔽环与排流线分别解决不同耦合和搭接问题。尾线长度会增加电感；匹配硬件和工艺下，360° 端接可改善较高频性能。单端、双端、机壳与隔离端接应遵循放行的系统设计，而不存在通用做法。

copy.en: Drawings should identify shield start, stop, splice, isolation and bonding hardware.
copy.zh: 图纸应标明屏蔽起止、接续、隔离与搭接硬件。

copy.en: Bond resistance and transfer behavior depend on finishes, joints, backshells and installation.
copy.zh: 搭接电阻与传输特性取决于镀层、接缝、尾罩和安装状态。

title.en: Strain relief begins at the connector and continues along the route
title.zh: 应力消除从连接器开始并贯穿整条路线

copy.en: Straight, 45-degree and 90-degree backshells, banding platforms, clamps, boots, heat-shrink transitions and overmolds affect cable exit, bend radius, shield termination, sealing and service access. Harness mass and unsupported length can load contacts or coupling hardware under shock and vibration. The connector accessory, cable build-up, clamp location and structure interface are therefore designed together.
copy.zh: 直式、45° 与 90° 尾罩、扎带平台、夹具、护靴、热缩过渡与包胶会影响出线、弯曲半径、屏蔽端接、密封和维修空间。冲击振动下，线束重量与无支撑长度可能对触点或锁紧机构施加载荷，因此连接器附件、电缆堆叠、夹具位置与结构界面必须协同设计。

copy.en: Braid, tape, conduit and boot layers must fit the accessory and preserve the intended clamp range.
copy.zh: 编织、胶带、套管与护靴层必须匹配附件并保留预期夹持范围。

copy.en: Route and clamp geometry should keep connector contacts from carrying bundle weight.
copy.zh: 走线与夹具几何应避免让连接器触点承担线束重量。

title.en: Every environmental method needs the right severity and configuration
title.zh: 每项环境方法都需要正确严酷度与样件配置

copy.en: MIL-STD-810 and component specifications contain test methods and tailoring guidance, not a single blanket certificate. Temperature, altitude, rain, immersion, dust, salt atmosphere, vibration, shock, acceleration, fluids, solar radiation and fungus answer different questions. Procedure, category, duration, axes, mounting, operating state, sample size and pass criteria must be selected by the responsible authority and tied to representative hardware.
copy.zh: MIL-STD-810 与元件规范提供试验方法和裁剪指导，并非单一通用证书。温度、高度、淋雨、浸水、砂尘、盐雾、振动、冲击、加速度、油液、日照与霉菌分别回答不同问题。程序、类别、持续时间、轴向、安装、工作状态、样本量与通过准则必须由责任方选定，并关联代表性硬件。

title.en: Tailor; do not copy a method number
title.zh: 应裁剪而非照抄方法编号

copy.en: The same method can contain multiple procedures and severities with very different meaning.
copy.zh: 同一方法可包含意义完全不同的多种程序与严酷度。

copy.en: Intermittent discontinuity, resistance change and functional state may need monitoring during exposure.
copy.zh: 环境暴露过程中可能需要监测瞬断、电阻变化与功能状态。

title.en: Approved sources and revision status are manufacturing inputs
title.zh: 批准来源与版本状态属于制造输入

copy.en: A controlled technical data package can include drawings, parts lists, approved manufacturer lists, QPL requirements, source-control documents, deviations, change notices, serialization and contract data deliverables. Procurement must preserve full part identity and traceability through receiving, storage and issue. Obsolescence, lead-time pressure or visual similarity does not authorize substitution; disposition belongs to the designated engineering authority.
copy.zh: 受控技术数据包可包括图纸、物料表、批准制造商清单、QPL 要求、来源控制文件、偏差、变更通知、序列化与合同数据交付物。采购必须在收货、存储与发料过程中保持完整型号身份和追溯。停产、交期压力或外观相似都不能授权替代，处置权属于指定工程责任方。

copy.en: Purchasing, fabrication, inspection and test must work from the same released revision.
copy.zh: 采购、制造、检验与测试必须使用同一放行版本。

copy.en: Prototype, deviation, rework, repaired and accepted conditions remain identifiable in records and marking.
copy.zh: 原型、偏差、返工、修理与接收状态需在记录和标识中保持可识别。

title.en: Preparation, calibrated tooling and in-process inspection protect hidden features
title.zh: 准备、校准工具与过程检验共同保护隐藏特征

copy.en: Controlled cutting, marking, stripping, crimping, soldering, contact insertion, shield termination, splice installation, lacing, sleeving, molding and potting each require the applicable instruction and acceptance criteria. Tool locator, die, applicator, calibration, maintenance and operator authorization form part of the process. Hidden conductor, shield, splice and seal features are inspected before backshells and coverings make them inaccessible.
copy.zh: 受控裁线、标识、剥线、压接、焊接、装触点、屏蔽端接、接续、绑扎、套管、包胶与灌封均需遵循适用作业指导和接收准则。工具定位器、压模、模具、校准、维护与人员授权属于工艺的一部分。导体、屏蔽、接续与密封等隐藏特征应在尾罩和包覆封闭前完成检验。

title.zh: 保护每根线丝与密封件

copy.en: Nicks, braid whiskers, displaced grommets and contamination can create failures after assembly appears complete.
copy.zh: 伤丝、编织毛刺、密封圈错位与污染可能在外观完成后形成故障。

copy.en: Solder, potting, molding and shield-band operations need controlled parameters and traceable inspection.
copy.zh: 焊接、灌封、包胶与屏蔽扎带操作需要受控参数和可追溯检验。

title.en: Configuration, workmanship and electrical behavior require separate checks
title.zh: 配置、工艺与电气行为需要分别检查

copy.en: Visual and dimensional inspection confirms materials, marking, geometry and workmanship. Electrical acceptance may include continuity, pin-to-pin mapping, resistance, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, shield isolation or bonding when compatible with the hardware. Data, RF, functional and environmental tests require approved fixtures, limits and procedures. Tests that could damage filters, transient protection or embedded electronics are not applied without engineering authorization.
copy.zh: 外观与尺寸检验确认材料、标识、几何和工艺。与硬件兼容时，电气验收可包括导通、针脚映射、电阻、绝缘电阻、耐压、屏蔽隔离或搭接。数据、射频、功能与环境测试需要批准的夹具、限值和程序。可能损伤滤波器、瞬态保护或内置电子器件的试验不得在未经工程授权时实施。

copy.en: Fixture, channel map, voltage, dwell, bandwidth, mounting and acceptance limit make evidence interpretable.
copy.zh: 夹具、通道表、电压、保持时间、带宽、安装与接收限值使证据可解释。

title.en: Do not confuse acceptance with qualification

copy.en: Routine production checks and one-time design qualification serve different purposes and sample plans.
copy.zh: 常规生产验收与一次性设计鉴定具有不同目的和抽样方案。

title.en: Protection, spares and records continue beyond final inspection
title.zh: 防护、备件与记录延续到最终检验之后

copy.en: Protective caps, minimum bend radius, moisture barrier, desiccant, ESD controls, preservation materials, coiling method, labels and reusable transit cases are selected for shipping and storage. Shelf-life items and date-sensitive materials remain traceable. Spares, depot repair, connector replacement and configuration updates need the same controlled identity as original production so field support does not create an undocumented variant.
copy.zh: 防护帽、最小弯曲半径、防潮层、干燥剂、静电防护、防护材料、盘绕方式、标签与可重复使用运输箱需按运输和存储选择。具有货架寿命或日期敏感的材料必须保持追溯；备件、基地级维修、连接器更换与配置更新也需保持与原始生产一致的受控身份，避免现场保障形成未记录变型。

copy.en: Packaging should not introduce tight bends, connector loads or shield deformation during storage.
copy.zh: 包装不得在存储期间造成过小弯曲、连接器受力或屏蔽变形。

copy.en: Part number, revision, serial or lot status and applicable platform remain visible through issue and repair.
copy.zh: 料号、版本、序列或批次状态及适用平台在发放与维修中保持可见。

q.en: Does ‘military-spec’ mean the complete assembly is qualified?
q.zh: “军规”是否表示整套组件已经获得鉴定？

a.en: No. Qualification applies to the exact product, specification, class, source and scope supported by current evidence. A project assembly must separately satisfy its drawing, contract, workmanship, inspection and platform approval requirements.
a.zh: 不是。鉴定只适用于当前证据覆盖的准确产品、规范、等级、来源与范围。项目组件仍需单独满足图纸、合同、工艺、检验和平台批准要求。

q.en: Can you build with MIL-DTL-38999 connectors?
q.zh: 可以使用 MIL-DTL-38999 连接器制作吗？

a.en: Projects using this family can be reviewed when the exact series, class, slash-sheet PIN, insert, contact, keying, backshell, mating half and approved-source requirement are supplied. The connector name alone is not enough.
a.zh: 在提供准确系列、等级、分规范型号、孔位、触点、键位、尾罩、对插件与批准来源要求后，可进行项目审核；只有连接器名称还不够。

q.en: Can an existing sample be reverse engineered?
q.zh: 可以依据现有样品进行开发吗？

a.en: A sample supports dimensions and interface study, but it may not reveal wire designation, derating, shield topology, hidden splices, sealing materials, approved sources or qualification history. Released engineering data and authority are still required.
a.zh: 样品有助于尺寸和接口研究，但可能无法揭示线材牌号、降额、屏蔽拓扑、隐藏接续、密封材料、批准来源或鉴定历史，仍需放行工程资料与授权。

q.en: Do you test every assembly to MIL-STD-810?
q.zh: 每条组件都会按 MIL-STD-810 测试吗？

a.en: No. MIL-STD-810 contains methods and tailoring guidance. Environmental testing is performed only when the responsible authority defines the applicable method, procedure, severity, mounting, operating state, samples and acceptance criteria.
a.zh: 不会。MIL-STD-810 包含方法与裁剪指导。只有责任方明确适用方法、程序、严酷度、安装、工作状态、样本和接收准则后，才执行环境试验。

q.en: What routine acceptance tests are available?
q.zh: 可提供哪些常规验收测试？

a.en: The baseline can include configuration, visual, dimensional and continuity checks. Resistance, insulation, dielectric, shield, bonding, data, RF or functional checks are added when the assembly is compatible and the test method and limits are released.
a.zh: 基础验收可包括配置、外观、尺寸与导通检查。电阻、绝缘、耐压、屏蔽、搭接、数据、射频或功能检查仅在组件兼容且方法与限值已放行时增加。

q.en: What information is needed for a capability review?
q.zh: 能力审核需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send the platform and zone, drawing revision, exact component identities and source restrictions, circuit and shield schedule, electrical loads and signals, route and support, environmental profiles, workmanship and inspection criteria, traceability, quantity and required data deliverables.
a.zh: 请提供平台与区域、图纸版本、准确元件身份及来源限制、回路与屏蔽表、电气负载和信号、走线与支撑、环境谱、工艺与检验准则、追溯、数量及所需数据交付物。
